summary: BUDAPEST: Ukrainian President President Volodymyr Zelensky has asked neighbors Poland, Romania, Slovakia and Hungary to allow the transit of Ukrainian grain cargoes ⁠due to a Black ⁠Sea blockade, Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on ⁠Saturday. Magyar, who agreed with Zelensky to reset Ukraine-Hungary ties at a bilateral meeting on Friday, said he would have no objections to ⁠the ⁠measure if the Ukrainian grain cargoes only passed through Hungary, private broadcaster RTL reported.
